sentences.text:
Petitioner :- Radharaman Singh
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 4 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Shri Krishna Mishra

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Rajeev Misra,J.
1.

The Magistrate concerned has passed order dated 30.09.2014 under section 26/54 of Food Safety and Standard Act, imposing penalty of Rs.1,00,000/- upon petitioner where-against petitioner has filed recall application.
Under the aforesaid Act there is no such provision for recall or permitting authority to recall such order of penalty.

2. Counsel for petitioner could not show any such provision under which mandamus as prayed for can be issued, therefore, no mandamus can be issued to the Magistrate to decide said recall application, since there is no provision authorising the concerned authority to recall order which it has already passed in exercise of statutory power.
3.
The writ petition is accordingly dismissed.
